short_description: The Bridje.Services CICS Producer and Consumer frameworks provide a common backbone capability for doing mainframe CICS integration to and from the distributed systems, via MQ.  Framework components are installed into MQ enabled regions (ie, CICS58), and enable SOA Integration to and from the mainframe.   Components are also installed in non-MQ enabled region to provide a bridge capability between regions, so that mainframe application functions and modules may be called as services, as well as their ability to call into other services.  On the distributed side, this framework is fronted by Websphere Message Broker (WMB) communications that are responsible for converting XML based messages into Cobol Copybooks, and invoking of the message transactions on the mainframe.  It is expected that this framework should allow us to retire the CTG framework.

name: Netskope CASB & SWG
short_description:
Netskope empowers CNA enterprise to secure and optimize the network traffic while providing enhanced control and visibility, it is a cloud-native platform with dedicated egress IP addresses to ensure that outbound traffic from CNA network is routed through a specific, controlled set of IP addresses for enhanced security.​

Features: 
Secure Web Gateway: The SWG component is responsible for inspecting and filtering web traffic. It acts as a proxy that intercepts and inspects HTTP and HTTPS traffic to enforce security policies, block malicious content, and provide content filtering​

Cloud Access Security Broker: The CASB component is responsible for visibility, control and security for cloud services and applications. CASB at CNA is deployed in 3 different modes​
Forward Proxy Mode: All user traffic on a managed device, including web, cloud applications and non-web traffic is routed through Netskope’s infra for inspection and policy enforcement before reaching the destination​
Reverse Proxy Mode: Netskope acts as a security gateway that sits between the user and CNA approved off network SaaS app’s​
API Mode: Secure and govern data interactions with cloud services and applications via APIs. Netskope monitors and enforces policies on API calls made by applications, ensuring data security and compliance.​

name: MARS Watcher
short_description:
Helix Mars Platform
Using our experience-based conversion methodology and powerful MARS Conversion Platform technology, we enable content migration from legacy systems into current ECM systems, or from one heterogeneous system of record into another. Our ECM solutions help clients improve information access while minimizing support needs, reducing licensing costs and eliminating redundant or obsolete technology.

Mars Conversion Platform is meant to manage the audits track all migrations and prioritize and provide reporting on end times, reconciliation, and scheduling tasks with priority and number of threads to handle bottlenecks and be agile in a production environment.

MARS Watcher
1. The first step taken by the Helix International MARS Watcher utility program is to watch all output data that it is set to receive.
2. The second step is the TEXT to XML process.
3. The third and last step of the Watcher utility is to present the converted data.

The data is presented based on your specifications during setup. Customize your output templates with your logos, fonts, page formats, calculations and more. There is no need to hire a specialist to make future updates. Our intuitive Graphical User Interface allows your system administrators to make stress-free changes.

To summarize Helix MARS Watcher allows for the processing of day forward reports and creating the data model to gather data from within the report and or attributes without having to recode. (it takes this from the legacy repository creating new rules) It has many out of the box processors for handling custom preprocessing from legacy systems minimizing the amount of coding to be done. (examples are preprocessing for international character sets, Extracting data from reports, receiving files from disparate systems).

Source: https://www.helix-int.com/mars-pltform#watcher

name: IBM MQ 9.x
short_description:
Introduction to IBM MQ
Last Updated
: 2025-01-30
An overview of what IBM® MQ can do, how you use it, how it works, and what tools and resources come with it.

What can IBM MQ do for me?
IBM MQ provides a universal messaging backbone with robust connectivity for flexible and reliable messaging for applications and the integration of existing IT assets using a service-oriented architecture (SOA).
IBM MQ sends and receives data between your applications, and over networks.
Message delivery is assured and decoupled from the application. Assured, because IBM MQ exchanges messages transactionally, and decoupled, because applications do not have to check that messages they sent are delivered safely.
You can secure message delivery between queue managers with TLS.
With Advanced Message Security (AMS), you can encrypt and sign messages between being put by one application and retrieved by another.
Application programmers do not need to have communications programming knowledge.

Source: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/ibm-mq/9.2.x?topic=SSFKSJ_9.2.0/com.ibm.mq.pro.doc/q001020_.html

short_description: Global Bank Reconciliation is used by the Treasury Analysis and Control area.  Its purpose is to track detail information used to reconcile CNA bank accounts.  Unresolved items are passed from reconcilement to reconcilement to have a complete listing of items that are open for each account.  All bank to book reconciliation is done by manually comparing the bank statement to transactions in the general ledger.  Additional information from CBR, Gateway, and issuing systems is also used in reconciliation. Additionally, GBR provides a feed of approved reconciliation items to the GL reconciliation panels for Scorecard reporting.

name: Merlin Investments Data Mart
short_description:
This application is in Sunset status as there are no new data feeds nor production processes running within it.  The data needs to be saved and can not be deleted per CNA's record retention policy.

The purpose of the Investments Data Mart (IDM) is to build from multiple data sources a robust consolidated data mart for Investments that will reconcile with the general ledger. 
Data will be received from multiple sources in different forms (Oracle tables, Flat Files, Excel Files, MS Access Tables) at different frequencies (Daily, Monthly, On-Demand, etc.). The data received from these sources consists of financial data at the ticket level as well as non financial data at both the investment level and the ticket level. Data will be loaded from the source to the IDM Staging area as is. Finally, data will be loaded from IDM Staging to IDM Target/Reporting using specific Business transformations and technical transformations.
